Q8258.reason: Z^n is free abelian of every positive rank n, and a f.g. abelian group with a generating set of size equal to its Betti number must be torsion-free, hence free.

Q8262.reason: The interval for p_male - p_female lies entirely below 0, so p_female exceeds p_male.

Q8264.reason: Units digits of powers of 7 cycle every 4 as 7,9,3,1, and 25 ≡ 1 mod 4, so the units digit is 7.

Q8269.reason: HK is a subgroup when at least one of H or K is normal, and every group of order p^2 is abelian.
